column1: # KenshiFP standing pose/presentation rules -> lab checks (spec-first). Read by Kenshi-Automation-Harness tools/animlab/spec.py
# (map / run / unarmed) and taste.py. Columns: id class rule source owner checks status note.
# owner: shay = Shay said it (memory / plan row "Problem (Shay)" / his review); coord = coordinator review verdict; native = shape and
# thresholds measured on the game's own animations (Shay 2026-10-10: "use the native in-game animations to guide you"); inferred =
# nobody confirmed it yet (question for Shay, batched via the coordinator; never treated as his rule).
# status: covered = an automatic check gates it; partial = gated only in part (see note); missing = no check; out-of-reach = no
# check possible with the data we record (note says why).
